blurb: Guests experience sea kayaking in Castine's Penobscot Bay near Acadia National Park and Bar Harbor. Tours are led by Registered Maine Sea Kayak Guides in small groups exploring marine life, geology, and local history. They offer customized tours and clinics for all skill levels from beginners to experienced paddlers.
